cohort: 110 women with breech presentation who delivered at Sir T hospital Bhavnagar between May 1, 2021 and April 30, 2022.
finding: Perinatal morbidity was higher in babies delivered vaginally compared to those delivered by cesarean.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with higher perinatal morbidity compared to cesarean delivery in breech presentation.
